In-App Notifications

The first of three channels reacting to the same events: a Notification row per event, and why a listener failing here must never affect the request.

  • A Notification Row per Event

    notifyInApp.listener.js: one domainEvents.on() block per event, each writing whichever Notification rows that event implies.

  • Why Every Listener try/catches

    A throw inside an async listener never reaches emit()'s caller — it becomes an unhandled rejection instead, which is worse, not better.
